notes.title: 1 Year of Hunting Update and Sale!
notes.notes: [p]It's been a whole year since Acorn Hunt released and we have a very special update to bring to you! But before we get into the game changes, I just want to say thank you to all that have been playing the game and supporting me through my semi-sporadic development.[/p][p][/p][p]Now onto the game changes![/p][p][b]V1.5.3.0[/b][/p][list][*][p]20 New maps have come for solo and time trial modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer now has the added option to play the previous season levels (giving 3 level options now, the OG, Autumn 24-Summer 25 and the current season)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]And the latest big update for the game!! [/b]SKINS!! You can now choose to play as Skylar, Rusty, or Lunar while you go hunting, and show off your favourite to your friends in multiplayer![/p][p][/p][p]There are plans to add more skins down the line, but for now, go be a wolf chasing down acorns![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44932319/65096bfc94471e1050d547ad214f9f530f883072.gif"][/img][/p][p]Oh, also, the game is 90% off for a week, so... if you don't have the game already, you should... And if you do already own it, gift it to a friend so you can beat their times with your ultimate skill![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again all and keep hunting![/p]

notes.title: Update 1.4.5.0
notes.notes:
It's been a while since the last announcement, being part time developers makes consistent updates hard, but updates have been going on in the background. We changed the game to the Spring graphics at the start of Spring and have been working on back end optimization for levels.

The big change is how the scenery is loaded outside the play area of levels. While this won't have a significant visual difference (although shadows seem to hold up better with the new instancing), there should be at least minor performance increases!

In other upcoming news, we are coming up to the one year anniversary of the release of Acorn Hunt!! In excitement for that we're happy to announce there will be a new visual feature coming soon!! While on release there won't be a large selection, it will start as in implementation update, followed by more options later down the line!

Thanks as always for your support and keep hunting!!

notes.title: Update Version 1.3.2.1
notes.notes:
[b]Multiplayer Feature Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Ghosts now fade as they overlap with your character.
[*] Multiplayer sessions hosted on a different version to you will no longer display in the server list.
[/list]

[b]Improvements to main menu[/b]
[list]
[*] Online services (time-trial and multiplayer) now deactivate when you aren't connected to steam network.
[*] Time-trial deactivates after season end.
[/list]

The time-trial deactivation is in preparation for the fall season due to release early September!

notes.title: Bug Fixes - Update 1.2.0.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.2.0.0
[list]
[*] Fixed multiplayer bug where lobby settings were resetting after returning to lobby.
[*] Fixed multiplayer bug where returning to lobby wouldn't always work, so you had to repeatedly return to lobby.
[*] Fixed multiplayer ghost option "first only" where all players apart from first would see all ghosts instead of just seeing the ghost of the person in first.
[*] Added multiplayer level complete background blur to be consistent with game style.
[*] Fixed mouse visibility bug when pausing where mouse wasn't visible outside borders of the pause image.
[/list]
